name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my investment property renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my investment property renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a general contractor, look for experience with investment properties and similar renovation scopes. Request multiple bids to compare costs and services, ensuring each bid is detailed and transparent. Check their license, insurance, and references from past clients. Review their portfolio to assess the quality of their work. A reliable contractor should offer a clear contract outlining timelines, payment schedules, and warranties. Good communication and a professional demeanor are also key indicators.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a general contractor with relevant experience, check their license, insurance, and references. Compare detailed bids and prioritize clear communication and a comprehensive contract.
